title: MCP Automation Patterns
desc: Router for MCP desktop/browser automation patterns. Read T1 for surface contract, T2 for desktop control, and T3 for stability ops.
steps: MCP ECOSYSTEM 2026: Talon (browser+computer-use), OculOS (desktop), OSA-MCP (macOS scripting), Mirroir (iPhone), Lilith-zero (security middleware) -- all expose automation via MCP. WKAppBot mcp command is well-positioned to be the Windows automation MCP server.
wkappbot_cli MCP tool: argv array maps all wkappbot commands including a11y, win-click, windows, ask. Use from Claude Desktop: {mcpServers:{wkappbot:{command:'wkappbot',args:['mcp']}}}
a11y via MCP: wkappbot_cli ['a11y','find','*Button*'] or wkappbot_cli ['a11y','click','{proc:notepad}#OK']
win-click via MCP: wkappbot_cli ['win-click','{proc:nfrunlite}','200','300'] -- elevated targets routed via admin Eye proxy
ROUTING T1 mcp-automation-patterns-t1-core T2 mcp-automation-patterns-t2-desktop-control T3 mcp-automation-patterns-t3-stability-ops
author: claude
